title: LoomNativeGraphBacklinksAndTransclusion
clause: Implement bounded native Surreal graph traversal, backlinks, wiki links and transclusion with project-qualified privacy.

current_source_discovery: Inspect stable-main graph, backlink, wiki, transclusion and overlay implementations and tests.
Capture query plans and baseline cardinalities before replacing Rust-side workspace scans.
stop_conditions: A traversal lacks explicit depth, result and time bounds.
Authorization cannot be applied inside the Surreal query before result materialization.

scope.summary: Restore Loom's connected-knowledge behavior using Surreal-native relations and bounded traversal. Backlinks and transclusion are core connectivity primitives for Notes and creative-domain modules, not decorative UI metadata.
forbidden_paths: Loading an entire workspace graph into Rust for ordinary queries
Transclusion that copies or mutates canonical source content
acceptance_criteria: Backlinks, outgoing links, typed neighbors and path queries execute as bounded Surreal graph traversals with deterministic ordering and pagination.
Wiki links and transclusions resolve canonical project-qualified identities, report unresolved/ambiguous targets and never create duplicate content authority.
Traversal enforces source/target scope inside the query and hides denied nodes, edge counts and path existence.
Cycles, deep graphs, deleted endpoints, cross-project shared links and concurrent relation changes return bounded deterministic results.
Native graph/backlink UI exposes provenance, source module, broken-link and denied-safe states with stable Argus identifiers.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal graph fixtures covering cycles, depth bounds, deletion, cross-project grants and restart.
Capture query plans proving native traversal and absence of workspace-wide preloads.
Run Argus graph/backlink/transclusion interaction and visual-state matrix.

same_project_private_resource_cases: A visible node does not reveal private inbound or outbound neighbors.
cross_account_negative_cases: Forged endpoints and cross-account path searches reveal neither edges nor counts.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Transclusion and path scope is the intersection of every participating resource.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Open graphs and transclusions re-evaluate after grant or context changes.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote backlinks remain quarantined until a local typed source mapping exists.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Degree, path length, unresolved candidates and timing do not reveal denied nodes.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: link, traversal, limit, unresolved and denial events
query latency, bounded-depth, dangling-edge and repair health
graph operation identity and UI freeze recovery context

risk_if_missed: Notes and creative assets remain isolated lists instead of a useful connected knowledge system, while naive scans become unsafe and slow.

risks: A graph query is native but still unbounded.
Cycle handling exhausts memory or blocks UI.
minimum_controls: Adversarial cyclic graph fixtures and Argus responsiveness proof.

research_provenance.selected_approach: Bounded native Surreal traversal with canonical identity, source-scope intersection and reference-only transclusion.
